model.title: Small Business Payment for Performance Act of 2026
model.meta: Small Business Committee · Rep. Pete Stauber (R-MN)

summary.text: The bill would amend federal small business contracting rules to allow small business contractors to receive partial payments while their requests for additional compensation are being reviewed. These requests, known as equitable adjustments, arise when construction contract terms change in ways that increase costs or affect the work scope.
